key_facts: July 20 MAJOR UPDATE (Bloomberg/Meduza, Financial Times, Ukrainska Pravda, LIGA.net, NV.ua, Kyiv Independent, Censor.NET, Reuters/Straits Times July 20): Zelenskyy held sequential one-on-one meetings on July 20 with six top contenders (five generals and one colonel): Mykhailo Drapatyi (2nd meeting in 2 days), Volodymyr Horbatiuk (2nd meeting in 2 days), Andrii Biletskyi (2nd talk), Ihor Obolenskyi (also met July 17), Oleh Apostol (met July 19), and Denys Prokopenko. Bloomberg & LIGA.net report Zelenskyy is reviewing 11 candidates; as of 6:23 PM July 20 the General Staff denied Syrskyi had been dismissed yet (requiring a presidential decree) and OP advisor Lytvyn said no appointments were expected that evening. Chief of Staff Kyrylo Budanov promised 'Work is underway. Results will follow' as protest organizers threatened an indefinite protest if Syrskyi is not removed by July 24. Split insider signals: (1) Mykhailo Drapatyi (0.42->0.44) is Bloomberg's 'leading contender', UP says 'most of our sources in the army are currently betting on Drapatyi', protesters chant his name, backed by Fedorov, met Zelenskyy twice July 19-20; (2) Oleh Apostol (0.09->0.22) surged as Syrskyi's preferred candidate per UP/LIGA and MP Yaroslav Zhelezniak's rumored frontrunner ('Apostol appears to have the best chance'); (3) Andrii Biletskyi (0.08->0.10) is Fedorov's other pick, met Zelenskyy July 19-20, on every shortlist; (4) Volodymyr Horbatiuk (NEW 0.09, replacing Pavlo Palisa) is Deputy CGS who met Zelenskyy twice July 19-20 to discuss defense strategy & international partner cooperation; (5) Ihor Obolenskyi (NEW 0.05, replacing Andrii Hnatov) is Khartiia Corps commander listed in LIGA top-4 & Zhelezniak top-5. Neither Palisa nor Hnatov appeared on any July 20 contender shortlist. Sum=0.90 (0.10 outside for Prokopenko ~0.035, Hnatov ~0.025, Palisa ~0.015, others ~0.025).
next_review_trigger: URGENT July 21 (T+0): Watch for presidential decree dismissing Syrskyi and formally appointing permanent Commander-in-Chief; update to 0.98-0.99 immediately upon official announcement.
